links.title_fil: Pasig Transparency Mechanism Ordinance (Ord. Blg. 37, s. 2018)
links.title_en: Pasig Transparency Mechanism Ordinance (Ordinance No. 37, s. 2018)
links.description_fil: Lokal na FOI ordinance: karapatan ng sinuman na humingi ng pampublikong rekord nang walang kailangang dahilan; dapat aksyunan sa loob ng 10 araw; may parusa sa hindi susunod.
links.description_en: Local FOI ordinance: anyone may request a public record without giving a reason; it must be acted on within 10 days; there are penalties for those who do not comply.

links.title_en: Ugnayan sa Pasig (FOI and feedback office)
links.description_fil: Tanggapan para sa FOI request, tanong, at reklamo. Inilunsad noong Hulyo 15, 2019. Maaaring mag-file sa social media, mobile, o personal.
links.description_en: Office for FOI requests, questions, and complaints. Launched July 15, 2019. You can file through social media, mobile, or in person.
links.note: No dedicated official URL found; link is a news source.

links.title_fil: EO Blg. PCG-16, s. 2022 (CSO Desk at People's Council)
links.title_en: Executive Order No. PCG-16, s. 2022 (CSO Desk / People's Council)
links.description_fil: Itinatag ang CSO Desk (Abril 18, 2022) para buuin ang Pasig People's Council ng mga accredited na CSO at PO at para sa partisipasyon nila sa pagpaplano, budget, at pagmomonitor.
links.description_en: Established the CSO Desk (April 18, 2022) to form the Pasig People's Council of accredited CSOs and POs and for their participation in planning, budgeting, and monitoring.
